title: I don’t know if this makes me feel better or worse.
content: I just came across Mall World while googling about recurring dreams and I feel…weird. My Mall World began after receiving TMS therapy. It has been every night since the end of treatment. My world has everything - school, casino, pharmacy, dispensary, convenience store, amusement park, train station, airport, jail, even a Chik Fil A! I actually have a job doordashing in Mall World and am now working at a warehouse looking building that seems to double as a college. All I know is that I suck at the job and my manager hates me. I even look after dogs for a family ‘in town’ sometimes. I feel so crazy even saying this. Maybe I am. Does anyone else have a job or am I just getting suckered into it in ANOTHER dimension 🥴🤗
